## HEADLINE
Software Engineer | Functional programming and distributed systems

## ABOUT
Software engineer solving problems with functional programming and reactive systems. Four years writing Haskell in production at NoRedInk, and before that Clojure on Nubank's lending infrastructure. Most of my career has been functional programming at companies running it at scale.

## EXPERIENCE

### NoRedInk
Title: Software Engineer II
Dates: April 2022 - Present
Location: Remote

Education software for classroom writing.

• Built the authoring layer for the in-house event platform that now carries all of the company's product analytics — every click and page view — into Snowflake and Mitzu. Proposed a GitHub-backed editor over the planned database-backed CMS: event definitions are versioned YAML and an edit opens a pull request, so review and audit came free with no new infrastructure, and non-engineers define events through it in production.
• A GitHub Actions job generates typed event clients for Ruby, Elm and Haskell from those definitions, so sending an event the schema does not define is a compile error rather than a gap discovered later in the warehouse.
• Led three language-model upgrades behind automated grading, against vendor retirement deadlines — running prompts against ground-truth datasets, checking score alignment, and translating between model behaviour and what the curriculum team needed pedagogically.
• Built the ground-truth evaluation script the moderation pipeline was missing, so later model upgrades are a repeatable process rather than a research project each time.
• Took a core writing-submission feature end to end — API, UI, tests, metrics, launch and post-release monitoring. The metrics showed teachers extending assignment due dates less often within the first month.
• Built translation and language support for English language learners: a reusable language selection component, speech synthesis across languages, screen-reader pronunciation of embedded foreign text, and right-to-left alignment.
• Run the company Haskell book club.

Skills: Haskell, Elm, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Datadog

### Nubank
Title: Senior Software Engineer
Dates: July 2019 - April 2022
Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Lending team, on the services that issue and service credit.

• Built and ran core lending services as Clojure microservices: account management, renegotiation, issuance, payments and dynamic underwriting.
• Led the real-time risk analysis work on customer data — drove the architecture, wrote the tech assessments, set expectations with stakeholders.
• Defined the team's stability index metrics, and the monitoring and alerting behind them.
• Contributed to Nubank's shared Clojure libraries, and built the backoffice tooling the lending team used daily.

Skills: Clojure, ClojureScript, Kafka, Datomic, Kubernetes, GraphQL, AWS, Prometheus
